description: Delay-code hours for ONE Realized To-Date scope: the same rollup as dvw-jfb-realized-delay-summary-v2 with the scope's area filter applied, so a project running two contracts on different ground does not show one contract's delays against the other's hours. The date window was already parameterised; only the area filter is new. Area matching uses the LEVEL-1 area id, the same level the reference app filters on. Empty filter strings mean every area, which reproduces the unscoped view exactly. Ids arrive as delimited text because published data views only accept scalar parameter types. Rewritten 2026-09-24. It used to INNER JOIN jfb_project_delay_codes and group by the code, which silently dropped every activity with no delay_code_id -- Torch Lake 152601's week of 2026-09-07 lost 9.72 h of uncoded STARTUP/SHUTDOWN and totalled 10.15 h against the reference app's 19.87 h. The reference groups by the activity's own category text and never looks at the delay code (weeklySummary.ts and realizedToDate.ts, both via isOperationalCategory), so this does the same: no join, one row per category, delay code irrelevant. A row is a delay when its category is not one of the productive ones -- the same allow-list as dvw-jfb-realized-daily-totals-v2's NOH and src/lib/operationalCategory.js. Zero-length activities are excluded, matching the reference's `duration_hours > 0` guard; they used to print as a 0.00 / 0% row.
direct_sql: SELECT btrim(da.category) AS description, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0) AS hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da WHERE da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.report_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND da.end_date_time > da.start_date_time AND upper(btrim(da.category)) NOT IN ('ACTIVE DREDGING', 'DREDGING', 'PRODUCTION', 'ACTIVE CAPPING', 'CAPPING', 'ACTIVE PLACEMENT', 'PLACEMENT', 'TRANSITION') AND (p_include_ids = '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') = ANY (string_to_array(p_include_ids, ','))) AND (p_exclude_ids = '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> ALL (string_to_array(p_exclude_ids, ','))) GROUP BY btrim(da.category) ORDER BY hours DESC

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range -- typically the captured week's Monday.

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range -- typically the captured week's Sunday.

parameters.name: p_include_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated jfb_project_areas ids to count, or '' for every area.

parameters.name: p_exclude_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated jfb_project_areas ids to leave out, or '' for none. Applied after p_include_ids.

columns.name: description
columns.description: The activity's own category text, e.g. 'Survey' or 'STARTUP/SHUTDOWN' -- one row per distinct category. This is the label the reference app prints; it is NOT the delay code's name, and two categories that map to the same code stay separate, exactly as the reference shows them.

columns.name: hours
columns.description: Summed activity duration in hours for that category over the date range.
